name: Adaptive Dual Contouring
aliases: Dual Contouring with Octree Simplification and QEF Constraints
definition: A method to extract a mesh from a scalar density function by building an octree, solving Quadratic Error Functions (QEF) at nodes to determine vertex positions, and generating a mesh from the resulting constrained vertices.
summary: Adaptive Dual Contouring extracts manifold meshes from scalar fields using octrees and QEFs, reducing vertex count by collapsing internal nodes while preserving sharp features.
